title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open\-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
   

  

 You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
   

  

 Working at Atlassian
   

  

 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
   

  

**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**
* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi\-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross\-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 12\+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point\-in\-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs


 Benefits \& Perks
   

  

 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Integration Engineer - Mediation
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Telecom Mediation Specialist with strong expertise in the deployment, integration, configuration, development, and troubleshooting of Telecom Mediation platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience on deployment of Mediation Platform across Bare Metal, Virtualized, Cloud, or Containerized environments, with a strong understanding of CDR processing, Online protocol knowledge, data transformation, mediation rules, network\-element integration, and upstream/downstream systems.
   

  

 Experience with automation, Kafka/real\-time streaming, cloud technologies, and Gen\-AI tools will be an added advantage.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Deploy, install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot mediation platforms across Bare Metal, VM, Cloud, and Container/Kubernetes environments.
* Configure and manage mediation workflows for high\-volume CDR processing.
* Integrate mediation platforms with various Network, IT, Core, Packet Core, Charging, Billing, and downstream systems.
* Design and develop mediation solutions for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, 4G, and 5G use cases.
* Perform end\-to\-end data reconciliation across network elements, mediation, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain mediation components, utilities, scripts, and automation frameworks.
* Use Java, C, Python, Shell, and/or Perl for development and automation activities.
* Build, deploy, and develop real\-time streaming applications using Apache Kafka or Apache Flink.
* Explore and leverage Gen\-AI tools to improve engineering productivity, troubleshooting, automation, and solution development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with telecom mediation platforms such as Ericsson Mediation OR Nokia/Comptel Mediation OR Amdocs Mediation/Oracle RBM
* Strong understanding of CDR structures, processing flows, mediation rules, parsing, transformation, and enrichment.
* Experience in end\-to\-end mediation solution design/development for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, and/or 5G.
* Thorough understanding of ASN.1/JSON/AVRO Schema/Parquet structures.
* Strong proficiency in SQL.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, C, Python, or equivalent programming languages.
* Experience with data parsing, transformation, ETL processes, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of large\-scale data processing.
* Experience in building, deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting Apache Kafka / Apache Flink environments.
* Understanding of real\-time/event\-driven streaming architectures.
* Experience developing real\-time streaming applications using Kafka is highly desirable.


**The skills you bring:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 5–12 years of relevant experience in Telecom Mediation deployment, development, integration, or solution engineering.
* Experience with cloud\-based mediation solutions.
* Recognized certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or Kafka will be an advantage.
* Experience in 5G mediation, IMS/VoLTE, real\-time charging, and cloud\-native telecom architectures will be highly desirable.
* Exposure to Automation and Gen\-AI technologies is an added advantage.

title: Analyst Senior, Managed Service(IntelliMatch)
description:
**Position Type**
 Full time
   

  

**Type Of Hire**
 Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
   

  

 Are you curious, motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are seeking professionals to join our FIS DIM Managed Service team. Supporting DIM Upgrade and Change team, responsible for supporting global FIS® Data Integrity Manager (DIM) clients. This role also requires hands‑on client interaction and coordination with cross‑functional teams such as Development, Product, Professional Services, and IT Operations to ensure successful delivery of changes, upgrades, and migrations.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 This role is part of the Managed Services team and is responsible for the delivery of the FIS Data Integrity Manager (DIM) Reconciliations Book of Work (BoW), Dedicated Projects, Upgrades, and Migrations for Managed Services clients.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities\~ The successful candidate will be involved in all the following aspects of the role. Primary accountability includes in the following sequence –**
**Ownership of Upgrade and/or Migration Projects**
* Support UAT activities and conduct thorough regression testing to deliver high‑quality, defect‑free changes to Production while ensuring platform stability
* Perform UAT for application and functional changes following application or platform upgrades
* Develop and implement required fixes or enhancements identified during testing to address platform or application dependencies
* Proactively eliminate duplicate testing by shifting all standard product regression testing scenarios from Support to Development
* undefined


**Ownership of BAU Activities and Changes**
* Onboard new reconciliations and maintain existing reconciliations in line with defined reconciliation standards to ensure the platform remains compliant with all non‑discretionary requirements, including mandatory changes, regulatory changes, and FIS software and hardware policies
* Design and implement changes in partnership with internal stakeholders, change delivery teams, and client teams
* Document all changes with the required test evidence, implementation instructions, and post‑deployment validation checks
* Drive optimization across existing scheduled jobs, matching rules, reports, and configurations
* Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve process efficiency and reduce manual effort
* undefined


**L3 Support and Escalation Assistance**
* Provide analytical and subject‑matter expertise to support broader strategic and operational initiatives
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify pain points, improve processes, leverage domain expertise, and drive automation and efficiency
* Resolve client escalations in collaboration with support teams and deliver clearly documented root cause analyses for client communication


**What You Bring**
**Technical Competencies**
* Candidate should have 4–10 years of overall IntelliMatch (FIS Data Integrity Manager) experience, with a strong blend of application support, reconciliation development, and change delivery
* Candidate must have a working knowledge of both ITIL and Agile methodologies, with experience operating in production support and project‑driven delivery models
* Strong hands‑on experience with IntelliMatch configuration, including reconciliation setup, matching rules, workflows, reports, scheduler jobs, and automation
* Proficiency in SQL (analysis, troubleshooting, data validation) and familiarity with IntelliMatch logs, database structures, and batch processing
* Good to have experience in DIM upgrades and/or migrations, including UAT coordination, regression testing, cutover activities, and post‑production stabilization
* Ability to independently analyse complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution in collaboration with L2/L3, Development, and Infrastructure teams
* Experience working in managed services environments, supporting multiple clients while adhering to SLAs, governance, and compliance standards
* Candidate is expected to support projects and managed services clients across APAC, EMEA, and US regions and should be comfortable working across global time zones, including overlapping business hours and shift‑based coverage, as required (rotational or non‑rotational based on business needs)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field·
* ITIL Basic certification – desirable· Agile Scrum/Kanban Certification – desirable


**Competency**
**(Professional \& Client Engagement Competencies)**
* Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential, as the role involves extensive client interaction (up to 50%), including requirements discussions, solution walkthroughs, and issue resolution
* Ability to mentor junior team members and provide technical guidance on IntelliMatch best practices
* Strong ownership mindset, with end‑to‑end accountability for deliverables across BAU, projects, and client escalations
* Exposure to process optimization and automation initiatives to improve efficiency and platform stability
* Demonstrates strong accountability, problem‑solving, and client confidence, especially in high‑visibility situations.


**What We Offer You**
* A modern, international work environment and a dedicated and motivated team
* A competitive salary and benefits
* A variety of career development tools, resources and opportunities
* Time to support charities and give back in your community
* A fantastic range of benefits designed to help support your lifestyle and wellbeing
* Great workspaces with dedicated and motivated colleagues
* A broad range of professional education and personal development opportunities
* A work environment built on collaboration, flexibility and respect


**Privacy Statement**
 FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
   

  

**Sourcing Model**
 Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Manager - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
   

  

 You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open\-ended problem\-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand\-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI\-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
   

  

**THE WORK**
 Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
   

  

**Supply Chain AI Strategy \& Use Case Development**
* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current\-state processes to AI\-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client\-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain\-specific AI initiatives.


**Client Engagement \& Advisory Support**
* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client\-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.


**Data \& AI Foundations**
* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous\-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A dynamic talent solutions firm operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and data engineering, we partner with enterprises to build scalable, secure, and high\-performance data platforms on AWS. Our engineers architect, deploy, and optimize data pipelines, lakes, and warehousing solutions that power real\-time analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence across industries.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Design and implement scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, and Step Functions for batch and real\-time data ingestion.
* Build and maintain data lakes on S3 with proper partitioning, cataloging (Glue Data Catalog), and governance using IAM and Lake Formation.
* Orchestrate data workflows via AWS MWAA or Step Functions, monitor pipeline health, and ensure SLA compliance.
* Optimize Redshift or Snowflake (if integrated) for performance and cost using materialized views, distribution keys, and query tuning.
* Implement data quality checks, lineage tracking, and alerting using CloudWatch, Athena, and custom Python scripts.
* Collaborate with analytics and ML teams to deliver clean, curated datasets for dashboards and model training.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Must\-Have
* AWS Glue
* Amazon S3
* AWS Lambda
* Amazon Redshift
* Amazon Athena
* Python
* SQL
* ETL/ELT
* Preferred
* AWS Step Functions
* AWS MWAA
* Apache Airflow


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Onsite collaborative environment with access to cloud certification sponsorships.
* Direct exposure to enterprise\-scale AWS data architectures and cross\-functional teams.
* Fast\-paced, learning\-driven culture with growth acceleration for high performers.

Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
   

  

**Position Description**

* Working knowledge of Apache Spark fundamentals and PySpark

title: Operations Insights Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Position Summary:
   

  

 The Operations Reporting \& Insights Analyst turns operational data into meaningful insights that help BNI India leaders understand business performance and take proactive action. The role collects, validates, analyzes, and reports data across company\-owned and franchise regions, with particular focus on Member gross additions, churn, retention, campaign results, and other operational measures. This position creates and manages recurring reports and dashboards, identifies trends and variances, and translates findings into clear, practical business insights for decision\-making.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities:
   

  

* Generate meaningful insights by analyzing operational data and translating findings into clear reports and recommendations that support proactive business action.
* Produce recurring reporting on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis based on business needs, including reporting on Member gross additions, churn, overall retention, first\-year retention, campaign results, and other operational measures.
* Create and manage dashboards that provide timely visibility into performance, while recommending and implementing improvements to reporting tools and outputs.
* Support performance analysis for the National Director, Regional Managing Directors, and India Operations Team by evaluating trends, variances, benchmarks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collect and validate data from company\-owned and franchise regions, challenging missing or inconsistent information and completing the data cleanup, restructuring, and reconciliation needed to produce meaningful reports.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Operations and regional stakeholders to gather business requirements, confirm reporting needs, and ensure outputs are relevant and actionable.
* Improve reporting processes to increase the timeliness, accuracy, consistency, and usefulness of business information.
* Apply business understanding to interpret data in context and convert analysis into clear presentations and decision\-ready reporting.
* Use digital and AI\-enabled tools responsibly to improve data validation, analysis, reporting, and workflow efficiency while applying sound judgment and protecting data quality.
* Demonstrate performance through timely and accurate deliverables, thoughtful analysis, and innovative approaches to reporting and insight generation.
* Any additional duties needed to help demonstrate our core values, drive our vision, and fulfill our mission.


 Demonstrated Competencies:
   

  

* Accountability \& Integrity
* Business Acumen
* Teamwork
* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Analytical Thinking
* Communication


 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Business\-level English proficiency
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce.
* Relevant experience of one to three years in management information systems (MIS), business analysis, or finance analysis.
* Excel proficiency with strong capability in data manipulation, data analysis, and reporting.
* Business understanding sufficient to interpret data,identify what matters, and convert findings into meaningful reports and presentations.
* Communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with senior leaders, Operations teams, and regional stakeholders.
* Data quality discipline with the ability to identify missing or inconsistent information and perform data cleanup, restructuring, and reconciliation.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Industry experience in a subscription, Membership, franchise, or multi\-region organization to support faster onboarding and familiarity with business requirements.

title: Technology Platform Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Platform Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Creates production and non\-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 SAP HANA DB Administration
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 Build and operate AI native, mission critical SAP HANA database platforms by combining deep SAP HANA database administration expertise with agentic AI capabilities (LLMs \+ tools \+ retrieval \+ evaluation). This role focuses on intelligent, autonomous ready database operations—predicting issues before impact, automating corrective actions, optimizing performance continuously, and enabling self healing behaviors—while ensuring security, reliability, and compliance across enterprise landscapes.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* SAP HANA Database Administration \& Lifecycle Management


 Administer SAP HANA databases across development, quality, and production environments.
   

  

 Perform installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, revisions, and database migrations with minimal disruption.
   

  

 Manage database start/stop, system replication, backups, restores, and recovery operations.
   

  

* Performance Tuning \& Resource Optimization


 Monitor and tune HANA memory, CPU, disk, and I/O utilization to meet performance SLAs.
   

  

 Analyze expensive statements, execution plans, and workload patterns to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
   

  

 Optimize data distribution, partitioning, and table management strategies.
   

  

* High Availability, Backup \& Disaster Recovery


 Implement and operate HANA system replication, backup, and recovery strategies aligned with business RTO/RPO objectives.
   

  

 Regularly test failover and recovery procedures to ensure operational readiness.
   

  

 Design resilient database configurations that minimize downtime and data loss.
   

  

* Security, Compliance \& Data Protection


 Enforce database level security: users, roles, privileges, encryption, auditing, and secure connectivity.
   

  

 Support regulatory and compliance requirements through controlled configurations and traceable operations.
   

  

 Implement data protection and privacy controls for sensitive enterprise data.
   

  

* AI Native Database Operations (Intelligent DBA)


 Build database operations agents that analyze telemetry (metrics, logs, alerts, SQL behavior) to:
   

  

* Detect anomalies and early warning signs of degradation.
* Recommend or execute pre approved tuning and corrective actions (cleanup, reorganization, parameter adjustments).


 Use retrieval grounded intelligence drawing from runbooks, historical incidents, configuration baselines, and performance guides to ensure AI recommendations are accurate and auditable.
   

  

 Enable conversational diagnostics for DBAs and architects (e.g., why is memory usage spiking , what changed after the last deployment ).
   

  

* Predictive Monitoring \& Self Healing Patterns


 Implement predictive alerting for capacity exhaustion, performance regression, and instability.
   

  

 Design self healing workflows with safeguards: automated remediation, verification checks, rollback logic, and human approvals for high impact actions.
   

  

 Continuously improve detection and remediation accuracy using feedback loops.
   

  

* Quality Engineering \& Evaluation Loops (DB \+ AI)


 Define KPIs for database health, stability, and AI effectiveness (false alerts, tuning accuracy, MTTR reduction).
   

  

 Establish evaluation harnesses using simulated incidents, golden configurations, and historical workloads.
   

  

 Continuously refine AI prompts, tools, and automation logic based on real production outcomes.
   

  

* Collaboration \& Platform Evolution


 Partner with Basis, application, integration, and infrastructure teams to ensure end to end system reliability.
   

  

 Support platform modernization initiatives including cloud, hybrid, and multi region HANA deployments.
   

  

 Maintain clear operational documentation and enablement for sustainable operations.
   

  

**Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)**
 Strong hands on expertise in SAP HANA database administration.
   

  

 Deep understanding of HANA internals: memory management, persistence, performance tuning, and replication.
   

  

 Proven experience operating high availability, business critical database environments.
   

  

 AI native capability: tool augmented automation, retrieval grounded diagnostics, evaluation loops, and safe action boundaries.
   

  

 Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
   

  

 Experience with SAP HANA on cloud and hybrid infrastructures.
   

  

 Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and automation frameworks used in enterprise database operations.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data protection standards.
   

  

 Scripting or automation skills to support operational tooling.
   

  

 What This Role Does Not Center On
   

  

 Training or fine tuning foundation AI models.
   

  

 Reactive, manual database administration without intelligence or automation.
   

  

 Value Delivered
   

  

 Highly available and high performance SAP HANA databases through predictive, AI driven administration.
   

  

 Faster incident resolution and reduced operational effort via intelligent automation and grounded diagnostics.
   

  

 Scalable, future ready database platforms supporting enterprise and AI workloads with strong governance.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 A 15 years full time education is required

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
   

  

 At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.
   

  

 Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.
   

  

 Senior Data Engineer
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Databricks Platform Engineer is the technical owner of our Databricks Lakehouse platform — the shared foundation on which enterprise data products, analytics, reporting and AI/ML workloads are built.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, automation, governance and cost efficiency of the Databricks platform. The successful candidate will have production experience operating Databricks as an enterprise platform, not just building on it. They will work AI\-natively and set that standard for the team.
   

  

 You will own the Data Platforms domain within a cross\-skilled Data \& Analytics Platforms engineering team. You will establish platform engineering standards, design and build infrastructure automation, create reusable reference architectures and engineering patterns, and ensure the platform can be operated reliably at enterprise scale. You will also mentor engineers and help build platform engineering capability within the India team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform ownership**
* Own workspace\- and account\-level architecture: Unity Catalog, compute policies, Lakeflow Jobs and shared compute infrastructure, identity and service principals, secrets management, audit logging, system tables, storage integration, platform upgrades and environment promotion across development, test and production.
* Design, build and review infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD and observability capabilities for the platform, establishing reusable standards and automation for the wider engineering team.
* Own platform reliability: availability, capacity, incident management, root\-cause analysis, and DR/BCP; define and meet platform SLOs for shared platform services.
* Run Databricks FinOps: consumption monitoring, cost optimisation, budget and anomaly management, and chargeback/showback with transparent unit costs for consuming teams.
* Implement platform security and governance controls: identity federation/SCIM, service principals, network controls, secrets, RBAC/ABAC, governed tags, row/column security and masking, PII handling, lineage and audit.
* Enable and operate the platform capabilities required for AI/ML workloads — MLflow, Model Serving, vector search and GenAI infrastructure patterns — partnering with analytics and AI teams on workload architecture, governance and cost controls.
* Build and maintain reference implementations and paved\-road patterns (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Auto Loader) that show engineering teams how to use the platform; enable consuming teams rather than owning delivery of their data products.
* Treat the platform as an internal product: understand consuming\-team needs, define paved\-road capabilities and self\-service patterns, track adoption and reliability, and continuously reduce developer friction.
* Own the platform roadmap: upgrades, new capabilities, deprecations.


**Engineering standards**
* Contribute to the team engineering handbook and architecture decisions; lead code reviews on platform and foundation work.
* Take part in architecture and engineering forums, communicating trade\-offs clearly to peers and global stakeholders.
* Maintain reusable patterns and automation used across the team.
* Establish AI\-native engineering practice for the team: how AI assistants are used for infrastructure code, test generation, runbooks, code review and troubleshooting, and where human review is mandatory.


**Mentoring and collaboration**
* Mentor engineers through onboarding, pairing and code review.
* Provide secondary coverage for an adjacent platform area as part of the team's cross\-skilling model.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of professional data platform or data engineering experience, including at least 2 years administering and operating Databricks in production as an enterprise platform (account and workspace administration, Unity Catalog, compute policies, environment promotion), not only developing pipelines on it.
* Demonstrated ability to design, build and review infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for data platforms (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or similar).
* Strong Python and PySpark; advanced SQL.
* Experience running platform operations: monitoring and alerting, incident management, runbooks, capacity and performance management.
* Experience with Databricks cost management and FinOps practices.
* Platform security and compliance experience: identity, service principals, secrets, network controls, audit logging, RBAC and PII handling, with an understanding of controls such as SOX.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems and system design for large\-scale data processing.
* Strong AWS fundamentals: S3, IAM, VPC and networking, KMS, and how Databricks integrates with them.
* Demonstrated effective use of AI\-assisted engineering tools, or a strong ability and willingness to adopt them, across coding, IaC, testing, documentation and troubleshooting, with sound judgement around verification, security and human review. Specific tools are not a screening criterion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with global stakeholders and lead technical discussion.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and/or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
* Experience operating platforms in compliance\-driven environments (SOX, GxP / 21 CFR Part 11 or similar): change control, audit evidence, access reviews, segregation of duties.
* Experience supporting, onboarding or mentoring other engineers.
* Experience taking over or migrating an existing platform estate.
* Experience working in a global delivery model with distributed stakeholders.

title: Data Engineer, Senior
description:

 At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all\-in\-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

+ Delta Sharing: Automate providers/recipients, share objects, and scheduled access reviews/expiry.
+ Unity Catalog Migration (HMS → UC or multi‑workspace to UC): discovery, wave planning, external/managed table registration, permission model migration, dual‑run validation (row counts, schema parity, query replay), cutover \& rollback.

title: Software Engineering Lead - Data Services
description:
Firmable is the market\-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace. Backed by leading investors and 2,000\+ customers, we exist to give sales teams an unfair advantage: the deepest company and people data of any platform, enriched with real\-time signals, served at the right moment by intelligent agents.
 



 The backend services, APIs, and AI systems behind every Firmable product are the engine room. This role owns it.
 



**The Role** 




 As Software Engineering Lead, you'll own the function that designs, builds, and operates the backend services, RESTful APIs, and AI/LLM systems powering every Firmable product. You'll lead two engineering pods through their team leads while staying deeply hands\-on yourself. Reporting to the Head of Data \& Services.
 



 This is not a people\-management seat. \~80% hands\-on architecture and engineering, \~20% leading the function. You whiteboard the system, write the reference implementation, then raise the whole team to that bar. If you want to step away from the code, this isn't it.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Backend and API architecture — Firmable's Python services (FastAPI, Pydantic, Logfire): the secure, well\-documented backbone every product, internal agent, and external customer depends on
* Data modelling — schemas, access patterns, and integrity at scale across PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and DynamoDB
* AI/LLM services and agents — production systems that are fast, idempotent, observable, and cost\-bounded; every LLM call a named, versioned tool with prompts, schemas, traces, and evals
* Harness engineering — the agent runtime the team builds on: tool\-calling and MCP server layers, structured\-output validation, bounded agentic loops, sandboxed execution, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, replayable traces
* Eval harnesses — scorers, labelled sets, trajectory and multi\-turn evals, LLM\-as\-judge calibration, regression suites in CI, drift detection on vendor model updates
* Scale and reliability — systems serving millions of API calls: idempotency, caching, rate limits, cost ceilings, circuit breakers, bounded retries, graceful degradation
* Observability standard — structured traces, p50/p95/p99 by stage, cost per request, and the dashboards that make it legible
* Function leadership — lead and grow two pods through their leads; run architecture and code reviews; set the bar for quality, testing, and AI\-native practice
* Cross\-functional glue — connect Data Platform, Application, and Product; turn early ideas into architecture decisions and working prototypes fast



**What We're Looking For** 




 Must Haves
 


* 7\-10 years hands\-on backend engineering, including time leading engineers or engineering leads with 3\+ years of hands on experience with Python.
* Built and operated large\-scale production systems — millions of API calls, and you know what breaks first when load grows
* Expert Python with deep production experience in FastAPI
* Shipped AI/LLM services, APIs, and agents in production — and stood up the evals that keep them trustworthy
* Harness engineering experience — you've built the scaffolding agents run inside: tool\-calling frameworks, MCP servers, eval and test harnesses other engineers depend on, and you can walk us through it in detail
* Hands\-on data modelling across SQL and NoSQL
* Designed and consumed RESTful services at scale
* Shipped real work with agentic IDEs — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent. Not "tried it" — your default mode
* Lead from the front — whiteboard to reference implementation to a team operating at that standard



 Highly Valued
 


* Eval frameworks (Braintrust, Inspect AI, Promptfoo) and tracing stacks (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)
* Agent frameworks and protocols — Claude Agent SDK, Pydantic AI, LangGraph, MCP
* AWS and/or GCP at scale — ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB
* B2B data, entity resolution, or high\-throughput enrichment pipelines
* Snowflake and modern data\-platform tooling
* Startup or scaleup experience where you shipped fast and owned outcomes end to end



**How We Build** 




 Firmable is an AI\-native organisation. Agentic development, AI\-driven test generation, automated review pipelines, and built\-in evals and traces are the default mode of working, not a productivity experiment. Recurring workflows ship as versioned SKILL.md specs any teammate or agent can run.
 



 We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. You need to be working this way already, and able to bring a team with you.
 



**Why This Role** 



* Own the engine room — you're not joining a team, you're leading the function
* Architectural latitude — the next generation of our services and AI platform is yours to shape
* Hands\-on leadership — the influence of a lead with the satisfaction of still building
* Massive leverage — your work reaches every Firmable customer, every day
* Competitive base \+ meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward



 Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
IMC is looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop trading signals and predictive models for our Options business. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with large datasets, and building models that drive trading performance, this role could be a great fit.
   

  

 You will focus on researching and developing statistically robust signals and models to better understand and predict options market behaviour. Your work will directly inform trading strategies and have a measurable impact on performance. You will also help shape the research direction by exploring new approaches and improving existing methodologies.
   

  

 IMC has strong advantages across market access, technology, and execution, and you will work in a collaborative environment alongside traders and engineers to translate research into production.
   

  

 Your Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and test alpha signals and predictive models for Indian options markets
* Perform large\-scale data analysis to uncover patterns and trading opportunities
* Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure robustness and reliability of results
* Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
* Collaborate with traders and engineers to translate research into production strategies
* Continuously improve models and identify new areas of research


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in quantitative research in NSE/BSE, ideally within derivatives or options
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
* Proven track record of developing impactful trading signals or models
* Experience working with large datasets and time\-series data
* Strong programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
* Curious, analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and innovation


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Platform Engineering Lead
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineering Lead (FNZ)
   

  

**About FNZ:**
 FNZ is a global fintech firm transforming the way financial institutions serve their clients. By
   

  

 combining cutting\-edge technology, infrastructure, and investment operations, FNZ
   

  

 enables wealth management firms to deliver personalized investment solutions at scale.
   

  

 Operating across multiple regions and supporting over $1\.5 trillion in assets under
   

  

 administration, FNZ partners with leading banks, insurers, and asset managers to create
   

  

 seamless and innovative wealth platforms that empower millions of investors worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineering Lead to drive the engineering delivery
   

  

 of FNZ's data platform. This role leads engineering efforts across the full platform scope —
   

  

 the Near Real\-Time Operational Data Store (NRT\-ODS), Analytical Warehouse, AI/ML
   

  

 capabilities, and Platform Security. The ideal candidate will own the technical delivery that
   

  

 evolves the platform from a data delivery engine into an industry\-leading insight platform,
   

  

 leading engineering teams across roadmap pillars including Data Trust \& Governance,
   

  

 Client Data Delivery, Lakehouse \& Fabric Integration, Stream Processing, Intelligence \& AI,
   

  

 Cross\-Client Analytics, and Operational Excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Engineering Leadership: Lead engineering delivery across the entire data platform


 — NRT\-ODS streaming platform, Analytical Warehouse (Microsoft Fabric), AI/ML
   

  

 layer, and platform security. Drive execution, remove blockers, and ensure
   

  

 engineering quality across all pillars of the platform roadmap.
   

  

* ODS Engineering Delivery: Own the engineering delivery of the streaming\-first,


 event\-driven platform comprising 179 Kafka Streams topologies, Debezium CDC
   

  

 pipelines, 200\+ Avro schemas (Apicurio Registry), OAuth 2\.0 security (KeyCloak),
   

  

 and Kubernetes\-based deployment. Drive performance tuning, reliability
   

  

 improvements, and feature delivery.
   

  

* Analytical Warehouse Delivery: Lead the engineering build\-out of the Analytical


 Warehouse on Microsoft Fabric, including Kafka\-to\-Fabric Direct Sink,
   

  

 Delta/Parquet storage on OneLake, semantic layer, and future Apache Iceberg
   

  

 adoption for time\-travel queries and multi\-engine access.
   

  

* AI \& Intelligence Delivery: Drive the engineering delivery of AI capabilities including


 Feature Store (Hopsworks/Feast), RAG over ODS documentation and schemas,
   

  

 NL2SQL for Gold data, and domain\-specific ML models. Ensure Flink\-powered
   

  

 feature computation pipelines are delivered to production.
   

  

* Platform Security Delivery: Lead engineering efforts for platform security spanning


 OAuth 2\.0, Conduktor Gateway, TLS, Kafka ACLs, multi\-tenant isolation,
   

  

 confidential compute (Azure Confidential Clean Rooms / Opaque Systems), and
   

  

 differential privacy (SmartNoise/OpenDP) for cross\-client analytics.
   

  

* Data Trust \& Governance: Drive delivery of data contracts on Gold schemas,


 pipeline validation (Great Expectations/Soda), end\-to\-end data lineage, automated
   

  

 anomaly detection, and regulatory automation (PII classification, DORA, BCBS 239,
   

  

 GDPR).
   

  

* Client Delivery Engineering: Lead engineering for multiple delivery patterns —


 streaming SDK (Vanguard), batch extract (BMO), MirrorMaker 2, WebSocket/SSE
   

  

 gateway, self\-service client portal, and the Wealth\-as\-a\-Service API (REST \+
   

  

 GraphQL).
   

  

* Cross\-Client Analytics: Drive engineering delivery of the three\-layer privacy stack


 — federated processing (data never leaves client boundary), confidential compute
   

  

 (hardware\-attested enclaves), and differential privacy on all outputs. Lead federated
   

  

 learning implementation using federated learning frameworks.
   

  

* Stream Processing Engineering: Lead the dual\-engine strategy — Kafka Streams


 for CDC processing and enrichment, Apache Flink for analytical stream processing
   

  

 (windowed aggregations, complex event patterns, streaming SQL). Drive
   

  

 performance optimization and operational stability.
   

  

* Technology Evaluation \& Selection: Lead build\-vs\-buy decisions across the


 platform — data lineage (Atlan vs. Purview vs. custom), observability (Monte Carlo
   

  

 vs. custom), confidential compute (Opaque Systems vs. Azure Clean Rooms),
   

  

 developer portal (Backstage vs. custom). Own proof\-of\-concept delivery and vendor
   

  

 evaluation.
   

  

* Team Leadership: Lead and mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and


 specialists across the data platform. Set engineering standards, conduct code and
   

  

 design reviews, and foster a high\-performance engineering culture.
   

  

* Stakeholder Management: Work with product owners and executive stakeholders


 to translate roadmap priorities into engineering plans, align delivery timelines with
   

  

 client commitments (Vanguard, BMO, RJ), and communicate progress and risks.
   

  

* Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce engineering standards — CI/CD


 practices (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), testing strategies, observability
   

  

 (Grafana/Prometheus), incident response, and operational runbooks across all
   

  

 platform teams.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a


 related technical field.
   

  

* Experience: 10\+ years of experience in software/data engineering, with at least 5


 years leading engineering teams delivering large\-scale data platforms.
   

  

* Streaming Platforms: Deep hands\-on expertise with Apache Kafka — topic design,


 partitioning strategies, Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, schema registries, and CDC
   

  

 patterns (Debezium).
   

  

* Analytical Platforms: Strong experience building and delivering modern lakehouse


 platforms — Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, and semantic
   

  

 layers and data transformation frameworks.
   

  

* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Extensive experience delivering on Azure (AKS, OneLake,


 Fabric, Key Vault, Managed Identities) with Kubernetes\-based deployments.
   

  

* Platform Security: Deep understanding of OAuth 2\.0, TLS, network segmentation,


 multi\-tenant isolation, and data encryption patterns in financial services
   

  

 environments.
   

  

* AI/ML Platforms: Working knowledge of feature stores, RAG implementations,


 vector databases, and ML serving infrastructure.
   

  

* Data Governance: Experience delivering data contracts, data lineage, data quality


 frameworks, and regulatory compliance solutions (DORA, BCBS 239, GDPR).
   

  

* Engineering Leadership: Proven track record of leading cross\-functional


 engineering teams, delivering against roadmaps, managing technical debt, and
   

  

 driving engineering excellence.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience working in the Wealth Management or Financial Services industry with


 strong emphasis on data governance and regulatory compliance.
   

  

* Experience with privacy\-preserving technologies — confidential compute,


 differential privacy, federated learning.
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Apache Flink for analytical stream processing alongside


 Kafka Streams.
   

  

* Experience with GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm umbrella charts, and platform engineering


 practices (Backstage).
   

  

* Track record of delivering platforms that serve multiple clients with distinct


 delivery patterns (streaming, batch, API).
   

  

* Experience with agile delivery at scale — sprint planning, backlog management,


 cross\-team coordination, and delivery reporting.
   

  

* Relevant certifications (Azure, Confluent Kafka) are a plus.


***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end\-to\-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2\.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
   

  

 Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: Data Architect
description:
**About Advanced Energy**
 Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know\-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin\-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award\-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Data Architect is a highly skilled data professional responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable data architecture solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives. Working within established enterprise architecture standards, this role translates business and technical requirements into practical data solutions that enable trusted, accessible, and high\-quality data across the organization.
   

  

 The Data Architect partners with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, data engineers, and analytics teams to design and optimize data pipelines, data models, integrations, and analytical platforms. This role applies advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex data challenges, improve data accessibility and quality, and support the successful delivery of data and analytics initiatives.
   

  

 The position operates independently on complex assignments, contributes to larger transformation programs, and may lead small projects or data architecture workstreams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Solution Architecture
* Design scalable and maintainable data architecture solutions aligned with enterprise standards, business requirements, and analytics objectives.
* Translate business and functional requirements into logical and physical data models.
* Develop architecture approaches for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption across cloud and on\-premise environments.
* Evaluate existing data environments and recommend improvements to support performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Data Integration \& Engineering Support
* Design and support data integration solutions for SAP ECC, SAP BW, SAP S/4HANA, and other enterprise systems.
* Define data movement, transformation, and integration approaches using Azure\-based technologies.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement ETL/ELT frameworks and reusable design patterns.
* Support performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines and processing workloads.
* Data Modeling \& Analytics Enablement
* Develop logical, conceptual, and physical data models that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.
* Design Lakehouse and modern data platform structures consistent with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Partner with analytics teams to ensure data structures effectively support Power BI and other reporting solutions.
* Recommend improvements to data accessibility, usability, and reporting effectiveness.
* Data Governance \& Quality
* Support enterprise data governance initiatives by incorporating data quality, lineage, metadata, and security requirements into solution designs.
* Collaborate with governance teams to promote data standards and best practices.
* Help identify and resolve data quality issues through effective architecture and design approaches.
* Ensure compliance with established security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Partner with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
* Communicate architecture concepts and technical recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Provide guidance and consultation on data architecture best practices and solution alternatives.
* Build strong working relationships across global and cross\-functional teams.
* Project Leadership \& Continuous Improvement
* Lead data architecture activities for small projects or defined workstreams within larger transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve data platform capabilities, development practices, and operational efficiency.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud data platforms, and industry best practices.


**Essential**
**Required Skills \& Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of data architecture principles, data modeling techniques, and data integration methodologies.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based data solutions within Azure environments.
* Hands\-on experience with
* Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL)
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\)
* Power BI
* Knowledge of ETL/ELT design and implementation methodologies.
* Experience with data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.
* Strong SQL development and performance optimization skills.
* Familiarity with SAP data structures and source systems including SAP ECC, SAP BW, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Ability to analyze and resolve complex data and integration challenges


**Experience**
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline and 5\+ years of relevant experience, OR
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related data management disciplines.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions supporting reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in cross\-functional project teams and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP extraction technologies including CDS Views, ODP, OData, or SAP Extractors.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or similar data governance solutions.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics, or other cloud data platforms.
* Domain knowledge in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, or Commercial Operations.
* Professional certifications related to Azure Data, Databricks, SAP Data \& Analytics, or Data Architecture.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex assignments with limited supervision.
* Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Collaborative approach with a focus on practical and business\-oriented solutions.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to technology innovation.


**Work Environment**
* Works in a standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment.
* Collaborates with global and cross\-functional teams.
* Works both independently and as part of a project team.
* May occasionally work outside standard business hours to support project requirements.
* Domestic and international travel may be required based on business needs.

title: Senior Partner Solution Engineer

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.
   

  

 Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.

Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.

**AS A PARTNER SOLUTION ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**

* Own the technology roadmap with the partners, to build and scale their Snowflake practices with reference architectures and delivery methodologies.

* Deep comprehension of Partner revenue models, industry priorities and challenges they navigate.
* Proven experience in designing and building highly scalable data pipelines using Spark, Kafka to ingest data from various systems.

* Experience with AI/ML use cases is a plus.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Technical Lead- Platform Engineering
description:
**Technical Lead – Platform Engineering**
***Where Growth Never Stops***
*At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance.  The Online Reliability Services Software Development team builds customer\-facing digital products that improve equipment reliability and performance for cement producers worldwide. As Fuller Technologies expands its in\-house software development capabilities, this growing team offers a unique opportunity to influence technology, engineering culture, and future product innovation.

 As Technical Lead, Platform Engineering, you will be the technical authority for our global Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) platform supporting Online Reliability Services (ORS). You will shape the architecture and technical direction across Edge connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data platforms, APIs, analytics, and customer\-facing applications.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead the development of secure, scalable, and highly available digital solutions that enable predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and data\-driven services for customers worldwide. Working closely with Product Management, Scrum Masters, software engineers, Edge developers, and domain experts, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions while driving engineering excellence, cybersecurity, continuous improvement, and platform innovation.

* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end platform architecture spanning Edge devices and connectivity, Microsoft Azure cloud services, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and customer\-facing applications.

* Drive continuous improvements that enhance platform scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, engineering productivity, and overall customer value.


**You bring**

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, industrial digital solutions, or related technology domains.
* 3\+ years of demonstrated technical leadership experience, providing architectural direction and guiding engineering teams in the delivery of enterprise software or cloud platform solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting production cloud platforms using Microsoft Azure.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, data platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Edge computing, industrial automation, manufacturing technologies, or connected equipment solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of engineering and technology principles, with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working within Agile development environments and structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Strong systems thinking, critical thinking, and complex problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues and drive effective solutions.
* Ability to evaluate technology alternatives, understand system dependencies, and make sound architectural and technical decisions.
* Proven ability to provide technical leadership, influence engineering teams, coordinate resources, and work effectively across multiple functions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working effectively in global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environments.
* A collaborative, accountable, and continuous\-improvement mindset with a strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and customer value.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*

 Master's Degree
